messages:
elaine: quick thought — ditch the full modal for create. try a compact right panel so users keep context when creating a key. mock uploaded.

 tom: I like that. decision: should primary CTA be 'Create & reveal' or just 'Create'? many expect immediate reveal.

 maria: dev note: panel is simple to implement. need explicit keyboard flow: open -> name -> reveal -> copy -> close. allow a 'skip reveal' path.

 nick: accessibility: announce reveal with aria-live: 'API key revealed. Copy now — this is the only time to see it.' use role=dialog + focus trap. don't auto-select for AT.

 tom: copy proposal: primary 'Create and reveal', secondary 'Create (hide secret)'. warning line under name: 'This key is shown only once — copy it now.' small help icon links to docs.

 maria: backend: when reveal=false return oneTimeDownloadUrl valid ~30s. API sketch: POST /api-keys {name,reveal:false} -> {id, oneTimeDownloadUrl}.

 nick: ensure download link has accessible label, rel="noopener", and visible focus state. announce expiry in UI.

 elaine: empty state rewrite: 'No API keys yet. Create one to get started — you'll only see each key once.' CTA: 'Create API key'.

 tom: rotate flow idea: guided 3-step sequence: 1) create replacement, 2) switch traffic, 3) revoke old. show checklist + progress.

 maria: i'll prototype keyboard flow and mock the one-time download endpoint.

 nick: i'll draft the a11y checklist and test with screen reader scenarios.

 elaine: I'll refine microcopy and run a 5-dev usability quick session. ux-bot: figma upload: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-panel-v3 :rocket:
